project_type: Pantry: Go barcode-inventory HTTP server (cmd/server) + React/Vite/Mantine SPA (frontend/) that talks to the Go API under /api. Verification skill lives in .agents/skills/verify-pantry.
language: Go 1.22+ (sandbox has go1.26) for the server; TypeScript/React 19 for the frontend.
build_system: Go: `go build ./cmd/server`. Frontend: npm + Vite. Playwright for e2e. The verify-pantry skill wraps launch/drive/teardown in scripts/pantry-verify.sh because background processes and /tmp do NOT persist across shell calls in this sandbox.
test_framework: Go: standard testing + apitest framework in internal/server. Frontend unit: vitest. Frontend e2e: @playwright/test with webServer config that boots `go run ../cmd/server` + `npm run dev`.
build_command: cd frontend && npm ci && npx tsc -b (typecheck) ; go build ./... (server)
test_command: Frontend unit: cd frontend && npx vitest --run. E2E: cd frontend && npx playwright test (needs Chromium + app running via playwright.config.ts webServer). Verify-skill drivers: bash .agents/skills/verify-pantry/scripts/pantry-verify.sh drive <driver.mjs> <evidence-subdir> from repo root.
verification_instructions: 1) Run doctor: bash .agents/skills/verify-pantry/scripts/pantry-verify.sh doctor (must end PASS). 2) Each new driver proven green via `pantry-verify.sh drive scripts/<driver>.mjs <subdir>` printing PASS and writing evidence/<subdir>/*.{aria.txt,png,sideeffect.json}. 3) E2E specs proven via `cd frontend && npx playwright install chromium && npx playwright test` (webServer boots app). 4) Frontend typecheck+lint+vitest still green.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. .agents/skills/verify-pantry/.gitignore ignores .bin/ (built binary) and evidence/ (run output) - never commit those.
setup_instructions: frontend/node_modules already present (persist in $HOME). If missing: cd frontend && npm ci. Playwright Chromium: cd frontend && npx playwright install chromium. Go build cache persists in $HOME.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. CRITICAL: background processes and /tmp do NOT persist between separate shell calls in this sandbox - only the repo and $HOME survive. Any 'run the app' step must launch, drive, and tear down inside a SINGLE shell invocation. pantry-verify.sh already does this and is the reference. For e2e, playwright.config.ts's webServer boots the app in-process (single invocation of `npx playwright test`), so running the whole suite in one shell call works.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: use built-in file tools, not shell for file I/O. CI workflow files must go through a PR (never pushed to master directly) and must never dump the whole environment - reference only specific env vars. Do not commit .bin/ or evidence/.
key_patterns: REAL current UI (grounded in source): (a) Scan queue default mode is stock_in, shown in an Alert titled `Mode: stock_in`/`Mode: stock_out`. (b) Direction is stamped from scannerMode at scan time; the Stock in/Stock out Tabs only change the VIEW, not the mode. To scan in stock_out mode the user scans the STOCK_OUT control barcode (default 'STOCK_OUT'), which calls setScannerMode and flips the banner + active view. A control barcode does NOT create a scan card (server returns early), so a mode-switch helper must wait for the banner text, not a card. (c) ScanEntryCard renders per-card `Approve` (exact) and `Remove` buttons for pending entries with a direction; a `Select scan for batch approval` checkbox (pending only); `Unit count` and `Expiration date` (getByLabel) inputs; a `Flagged` badge + FlaggedEntryResolver (Search products combobox, Use selected product, Create new product fieldset with Product name/Category/Unit of measure + `Create and use product`) for flagged entries. (d) Batch path: per-card `Select scan for batch approval` checkbox or `Select all eligible scans for batch approval`, then `Approve N selected` button in the `Approve scans` section. (e) NO `Select for batch review` checkbox, NO `Direction` select, NO `Commit N selected` button exist (these are the stale selectors). (f) Inventory: ItemRow shows `<n> <unit>` and a `View instances`/`Hide instances` toggle; ItemInstanceList renders expiry as medium/UTC e.g. `Expires Jan 10, 2030`. SuggestionPanel: `Get suggestion` -> with insufficient history shows manual mode: `Manual target quantity` NumberInput + `Save manual target`, confirmed by `Target quantity set to <n>.` (g) Shopping list: `Add an item` form has `Pantry item` NativeSelect + `Quantity` + `Add to shopping list`; entries Table `Shopping list entries` with Source badge `Derived`(auto)/`Manual`; purchase/remove buttons are `Mark <product> purchased` / `Remove <product>`. IMPORTANT: derived (auto) entries have empty id and NO action buttons (they show 'Updates when inventory changes'); only manual (and materialized) entries expose Mark/Remove buttons.
directory_structure: cmd/server (Go entrypoint + main_test.go), internal/ (server, scan, inventory, product, suggestion, shopping packages), frontend/ (React SPA; src/components/{queue,inventory,shopping,suggestions,scanner,product}; e2e/ Playwright specs; playwright.config.ts), .agents/skills/verify-pantry (SKILL.md, features/*.md, scripts/{harness.mjs,drive-stock-in.mjs,pantry-verify.sh}; .bin/ and evidence/ git-ignored), .github/workflows/{ci.yml,release.yml}.
